mapper.sql: sc.id, sc.student_id, sc.offering_id, sc.usual_score, sc.exam_score, sc.total_score, sc.grade_point, sc.status, sc.is_retake, sc.input_by, sc.input_time, sc.publish_time, sc.remark, sc.create_time, sc.update_time, s.student_no AS studentNo, s.name AS studentName, c.class_name AS className, cc.course_code AS courseCode, cc.course_name AS courseName, cc.credit AS credit, cc.course_type AS courseType, t.name AS teacherName, sem.semester_name AS semesterName, o.semester_id AS semesterId

FROM score_record sc INNER JOIN stu_student s ON s.id = sc.student_id AND s.deleted = 0 INNER JOIN course_offering o ON o.id = sc.offering_id AND o.deleted = 0 INNER JOIN course_course cc ON cc.id = o.course_id AND cc.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN base_class c ON c.id = s.class_id AND c.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN tea_teacher t ON t.id = o.teacher_id AND t.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN base_semester sem ON sem.id = o.semester_id
mapper.select: SELECT CASE WHEN sc.total_score >= 90 THEN '优秀(90-100)' WHEN sc.total_score >= 80 THEN '良好(80-89)' WHEN sc.total_score >= 70 THEN '中等(70-79)' WHEN sc.total_score >= 60 THEN '及格(60-69)' ELSE '不及格(<60)' END AS name, COUNT(*) AS value FROM score_record sc WHERE sc.offering_id = #{offeringId} AND sc.total_score IS NOT NULL GROUP BY name ORDER BY MIN(sc.total_score) DESC

SELECT cc.course_name AS name, IFNULL(ROUND(AVG(sc.total_score), 2), 0) AS avgScore, COUNT(*) AS totalCount, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN sc.total_score >= 60 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS passCount, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN sc.total_score >= 90 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS excellentCount, IFNULL(MAX(sc.total_score), 0) AS maxScore, IFNULL(MIN(sc.total_score), 0) AS minScore FROM score_record sc INNER JOIN course_offering o ON o.id = sc.offering_id AND o.deleted = 0 INNER JOIN course_course cc ON cc.id = o.course_id AND cc.deleted = 0 INNER JOIN stu_student s ON s.id = sc.student_id AND s.deleted = 0 WHERE sc.total_score IS NOT NULL AND s.class_id = #{classId} AND o.semester_id = #{semesterId} GROUP BY cc.id, cc.course_name ORDER BY avgScore DESC

SELECT COUNT(*) AS courseCount, IFNULL(ROUND(AVG(sc.total_score), 2), 0) AS avgScore, IFNULL(ROUND(AVG(sc.grade_point), 2), 0) AS avgPoint, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN sc.total_score >= 60 THEN cc.credit ELSE 0 END), 0) AS earnedCredit, IFNULL(SUM(cc.credit), 0) AS totalCredit, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN sc.total_score >= 90 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS excellentCount, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN sc.total_score < 60 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS failCount, IFNULL(MAX(sc.total_score), 0) AS maxScore FROM score_record sc INNER JOIN course_offering o ON o.id = sc.offering_id AND o.deleted = 0 INNER JOIN course_course cc ON cc.id = o.course_id AND cc.deleted = 0 WHERE sc.student_id = #{studentId}

SELECT COUNT(*) AS totalCount, IFNULL(ROUND(AVG(sc.total_score), 2), 0) AS avgScore, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN sc.total_score >= 60 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS passCount, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN sc.total_score < 60 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS failCount, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN sc.total_score >= 90 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS excellentCount, IFNULL(MAX(sc.total_score), 0) AS maxScore, IFNULL(MIN(sc.total_score), 0) AS minScore FROM score_record sc WHERE sc.offering_id = #{offeringId} AND sc.total_score IS NOT NULL

SELECT CASE WHEN total_score >= 90 THEN '优秀(90-100)' WHEN total_score >= 80 THEN '良好(80-89)' WHEN total_score >= 70 THEN '中等(70-79)' WHEN total_score >= 60 THEN '及格(60-69)' ELSE '不及格(<60)' END AS name, COUNT(*) AS value FROM score_record WHERE total_score IS NOT NULL AND status = 2 GROUP BY name ORDER BY MIN(total_score) DESC

SELECT CASE WHEN sc.total_score >= 90 THEN '优秀(90-100)' WHEN sc.total_score >= 80 THEN '良好(80-89)' WHEN sc.total_score >= 70 THEN '中等(70-79)' WHEN sc.total_score >= 60 THEN '及格(60-69)' ELSE '不及格(<60)' END AS name, COUNT(*) AS value FROM score_record sc WHERE sc.student_id = #{studentId} AND sc.total_score IS NOT NULL GROUP BY name ORDER BY MIN(sc.total_score) DESC

SELECT s.name AS studentName, s.student_no AS studentNo, ROUND(AVG(sc.total_score), 2) AS avgScore, SUM(CASE WHEN sc.total_score >= 60 THEN cc.credit ELSE 0 END) AS earnedCredit FROM score_record sc INNER JOIN stu_student s ON s.id = sc.student_id AND s.deleted = 0 INNER JOIN course_offering o ON o.id = sc.offering_id AND o.deleted = 0 INNER JOIN course_course cc ON cc.id = o.course_id AND cc.deleted = 0 WHERE s.class_id = #{classId} AND sc.total_score IS NOT NULL AND o.semester_id = #{semesterId} GROUP BY s.id, s.name, s.student_no ORDER BY avgScore DESC LIMIT #{limit}
